title: Jesus... My Dad Lost His Job And Still Leaves Every Morning
topic: father lost his job and still leaves every morning as if going to work

bible.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I saw my dad sitting alone in the park at noon today. He told us he was at work. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: He lost his job. He's been leaving in his office shirt every morning so we won't find out.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: He isn't lying to hurt you. He's trying to carry it alone so you won't have to.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I'm not a kid anymore. Why won't he just tell me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because to him, being your dad means being strong. Right now he feels like he's failing at the thing he cares about most.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So what do I do? Pretend I never saw him?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tonight, just sit with him. You don't need the right words. Let him know he doesn't have to hold this by himself.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: His strength was never supposed to come from a job. It comes from Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Who is quietly carrying something for your family right now? 🙏
